title: Nathan Fillion to Voice Guy Gardner in DC's Animated 'Mister Miracle' Series
text:
Nathan Fillion will reprise his role as Guy Gardner in the upcoming animated series 'Mister Miracle', bringing the brash Green Lantern to the world of Scott Free. This crossover highlights the interconnected nature of DC's multiverse and sets the stage for potential character development and plot twists.
Nathan Fillion's character, Guy Gardner, known as the 'Green Lantern with an Attitude,' has been confirmed to appear in the upcoming animated series ' Mister Miracle'.
This will be Fillion's fourth outing as the character for DC Studios, following his roles in 'The Suicide Squad' and 'Peacemaker', where he established himself as a key figure in the new DC universe. The decision to include Guy Gardner in 'Mister Miracle' is particularly significant because of the character's deep connection to Maxwell Lord and the Justice League International, which has been a strong influence on James Gunn's vision for the DCU.
Fans can expect to see Guy Gardner's trademark confidence and brash behavior clash with the otherworldly setting of 'Mister Miracle', potentially leading to new alliances or rivalries
